cases.name: record-basic
cases.extra: public record struct P{public int a; public int b; public P(int a,int b){this.a=a;this.b=b;}} public class Q{public P p; public Q(P p){this.p=p;}} public record struct Box<T>{public T value; public Box(T v){this.value=v;}}

cases.name: record-copy
cases.body:
var p=P(1,2)
let q=p
p.a=5
return q.a*10+p.a
cases.cs: var p=new P(1,2); P q=p; p.a=5; return q.a*10+p.a;
cases.extra: public record struct P{public int a; public int b; public P(int a,int b){this.a=a;this.b=b;}} public class Q{public P p; public Q(P p){this.p=p;}} public record struct Box<T>{public T value; public Box(T v){this.value=v;}}
